295: # One cloud transfer at a time (F-CS-23): the lock every other cloud script
296: # takes, for --apply only -- the check reads and writes nothing, as the
297: # match preview does. Without it a startup or game-exit sync could write
298: # into the folder this was moving. The same descriptor discipline as the
299: # others: the body runs with fd 9 closed, so nothing it starts holds the
300: # lock. Exit 75 is the skip EmulationStation names.
301: CLOUD_SYNC_LOCK=/var/run/cloud_sync.lock
302: take_cloud_lock() {
303:     local tries=0
304:     exec 9>"${CLOUD_SYNC_LOCK}"
305:     while ! flock -n 9; do
306:         if [ "${tries}" -ge 4 ]; then
307:             echo "Skipped: another cloud sync is already running. Try again when it's done."
308:             exit 75
309:         fi
310:         tries=$((tries + 1))
311:         sleep 0.25
312:     done
313: }

946: # belong. 0 when the device now points at the current layout, 3 when there
947: # was nothing to follow, 1 when the conf could not be written.
948: layout_follow() { # <remote> <saves> <backups> <content>
949:     local remote="$1" saves="$2" backups="$3" content="$4" keep
950:     same_folder "${saves}" "${NEW_SAVES}" && return 3
951:     superseded_default "${saves}" || return 3
952:     keep=$(conf_value LAYOUT_KEEP) || return 2
953:     [ -n "${keep}" ] && same_folder "${saves}" "${keep}" && return 3
954:     # One listing for the usual answer, "no device has moved yet": the
955:     # current folder's parent, which names Saves/ once it exists (exists()
956:     # would list the folder and then its parent, two rclone starts).
957:     list_or_stop "${remote}${NEW_SAVES%/*}/" --dirs-only
958:     printf '%s\n' "${LISTING}" | grep -qxF -- "${NEW_SAVES##*/}/" || return 3
959:     # A device whose old folder still holds files is not followed: they
960:     # would be stranded in a folder nothing reads once the pointer moves
961:     # (the futro's pre-mortem, 2026-10-01). The move is offered instead,
962:     # which copies, verifies and only then removes.
963:     has_files "${remote}${saves}/" && return 3
964:     backup_pointer_for "${remote}" "${backups}" "${NEW_BACKUPS}"
965:     local -a pointers=(SAVES_REMOTE "${NEW_SAVES}" SETTINGS_REMOTE "${NEXT_BACKUPS}")
966:     # Content follows only where it was derived from the old folder or
967:     # never set; a folder the player chose for ROMs stays theirs.
968:     if content_unset || same_folder "${content}" "$(derived_content "$(folder_abs "${saves}")")" \
969:        || same_folder "${content}" "${saves%/}/Content"; then
970:         pointers+=(CONTENT_REMOTE "${NEW_CONTENT}")
971:     fi
972:     set_pointers "${pointers[@]}" || return 1
973:     say "Followed: this device now uses ${remote}${NEW_SAVES}, which another device already made."
974:     logger -t cloud_migrate_layout "followed the fleet from ${saves} to ${NEW_SAVES}" 2>/dev/null
975:     return 0
976: }

1662: # --needs-step: whether the cloud folder step has something to settle
1663: # (D-CLOUD-170), asked at every boot, so no network and no rclone start: the
1664: # saves folder is a default this project once shipped, the player has not
1665: # kept it, and a remote is set up. 0 when it has, 1 when not, 2 when the
1666: # conf cannot be read -- which settles nothing, so the step stays away.
1667: # Names compared as written, case included: with no network there is no
1668: # asking the cloud whether it folds case, and a hand-typed /games that a
1669: # case-sensitive cloud calls the player's own would put the scan up at
1670: # every boot for nothing. The scripts write the defaults in their own case.
1671: if [ "${1:-}" = "--needs-step" ]; then
1672:     CASE_INSENSITIVE=0
1673:     if [ -e "${MIGRATION_RECORD}" ]; then
1674:         grep -q '^\[' /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf 2>/dev/null || exit 1
1675:         exit 0
1676:     fi
1677:     _saves=$(conf_value SAVES_REMOTE) || exit 2
1678:     _keep=$(conf_value LAYOUT_KEEP) || exit 2
1679:     if same_folder "${_saves}" "${NEW_SAVES}"; then
1680:         _backups=$(conf_value SETTINGS_REMOTE) || exit 2
1681:         _content=$(conf_value CONTENT_REMOTE) || exit 2
1682:         if same_folder "${_backups}" "${NEW_BACKUPS}" && historical_content "${_content}"; then
1683:             grep -q '^\[' /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf 2>/dev/null || exit 1
1684:             exit 0
1685:         fi
1686:     fi
1687:     superseded_default "${_saves}" || exit 1
1688:     [ -n "${_keep}" ] && same_folder "${_saves}" "${_keep}" && exit 1
1689:     grep -q '^\[' /storage/.config/rclone/rclone.conf 2>/dev/null || exit 1
1690:     exit 0
1691: fi
1692: [ "${1:-}" = "--apply" ] && take_cloud_lock
1693: main "$@" 9>&-

25: # still on an earlier folder joins it (cloud_migrate_layout --join), and a
26: # device on a superseded folder whose current folder another device has
27: # already made is re-pointed to it (cloud_migrate_layout --follow;
28: # D-CLOUD-160's "your other devices will follow"). Nothing in the cloud
29: # changes, so no lock is taken and a sync may run beside it.

202: read_folder() {
203:     local layout rc
204:     echo ">>> unit CLOUD FOLDER||"
205:     echo ">>> doing scan"
206:     layout=$(sibling cloud_migrate_layout)
207:     # A fresh install beside a fleet still on the earlier folder joins it first
208:     # (cloud_migrate_layout --join, a setting): the state below then reads the
209:     # folder the player's saves are in, and the move is offered from there
210:     # rather than CREATE IT beside them. 3 is "nothing to join"; anything else
211:     # that is not 0 is the cloud not answering, and stops the scan with its why.
212:     timeout 20 "${layout}" --join > "${OUT}/join" 2>&1; rc=$?
213:     case "${rc}" in
214:         0) log "scan: joined the fleet's earlier folder" ;;
215:         3) ;;
216:         *) stop_on "${rc}" "--join" "${OUT}/join" ;;
217:     esac
218:     "${layout}" --state > "${OUT}/state" 2>/dev/null; stop_on $? "--state" "${OUT}/state"
219:     # A device left on a superseded folder with nothing in it, whose current
220:     # folder another device has already made, follows the fleet here -- the
221:     # one place it does since no sync asks any more (D-CLOUD-170): the dialogs
222:     # then never ask about a folder the player has already answered for
223:     # elsewhere.
224:     if [ "$(sed -n 's/^STATE=//p' "${OUT}/state")" = superseded-empty ] \
225:        && [ "$(sed -n 's/^CURRENT_EXISTS=//p' "${OUT}/state")" = 1 ]; then
226:         timeout 20 "${layout}" --follow > "${OUT}/follow" 2>&1; rc=$?
227:         case "${rc}" in
228:             0) log "scan: followed the fleet to the current layout" ;;
229:             3) ;; # The remote may have changed since the state read; read it again.
230:             *) stop_on "${rc}" "--follow" "${OUT}/follow" ;;
231:         esac
232:         "${layout}" --state > "${OUT}/state" 2>/dev/null; stop_on $? "--state" "${OUT}/state"
233:     fi
